subject: Meridian POC — request for soft-claim & capacity triage
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Meridian POC — request for soft-claim & capacity triage

Hi team,

Meridian (Emma/Jordan copied below) just moved our POC to late-stage — they want a predictable Dedicated window for a 6–8 week POC starting late Nov. High-level ask: 12 A100-80GB-equivalent GPUs (they might take H100s if available), with a hard throughput requirement during evaluation hours (US PST 10:00–18:00).

Can we validate fleet availability across commitments and any upcoming scheduled maintenance? Specific asks:
- Can Ops provide a conservative availability window (H100/A100 counts, and whether any quantized/4-bit variants are compatible)?
- If we put a 30-day soft-claim (non-binding hold), what ops-level flags do we set to ensure the booking is respected without blocking other enterprise-slas?
- Any risks from quarter-end rebalancing or reserved customer rollouts in Nov–Dec?

I attached the initial capacity matrix they gave and a one-page MOU draft for a soft-claim. Meeting with Meridian scheduled for Thu 10/4 to confirm dates — need ops read by EOD tomorrow so we can confirm language.

Thanks —
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
443-555-0118
Attachment: Meridian_SoftClaim_MOU_v1.pdf (pdf, 42 KB)
Attachment: capacity_matrix_20281002.csv (csv, 5 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Meridian POC — request for soft-claim & capacity triage

Irene — thanks for the heads up. Quick inventory check below (conservative numbers, accounting for scheduled maintenance windows and existing dedicated pools):

- H100 (80GB) nodes available: 9 units (can be provisioned for dedicated pools, cross-checked w/ reserved commitments).
- A100 (80GB) nodes available: 18 units (higher availability; could be used for mixed-setup).
- Quantized 4-bit variants: supported on A100 via recent quant pipeline; H100 path needs validation for specific model kernels (we can run a short compatibility test).

Risk notes:
- There is a medium risk window Nov 20–30 due to region maintenance and a large reserved onboarding (internal deal ID R-2028-77) — I recommend we avoid committing the last 4 H100s in that window.
- If Meridian accepts an A100-first plan (12 x A100), we can guarantee the 6–8 week POC with the soft-claim + canary fallback to H100 for peak hours.

Operational proposal:
1) Create a 30-day soft-claim ticket in Ops with tag: soft-claim:meridian-2028-0937 and set priority to 'sales-hold'.
2) Flag the 12 GPUs (mix A100/H100) as 'standby' in the scheduler (not fully excluded from autoscaling but deprioritized for opportunistic allocation).
3) Run model-compat test (2–4 hours) against 1 H100 + 1 A100 to validate performance delta.

I can create the ticket and run the basic compatibility test today if you want.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference
Attachment: capacity_matrix_20281002.csv (updated, csv, 6 KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@meridian.ai>, Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@meridian.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 16:22:00 +0000
Subject: FW: Meridian POC — request for soft-claim & capacity triage

Emma / Jordan — looping you in on our internal ops triage. Short summary: we can provision the requested capacity but need a short soft-claim window to reserve resources during the late-Nov schedule risk.

Attached is a one-page soft-claim MOU (non-binding) that documents: requested capacity, proposed POC dates, and the 30-day soft-claim hold language. If that works, sign and return and we'll activate the operational hold and run a quick H100/A100 compatibility test.

Next steps for you:
- Can you confirm the target start date (we suggested Nov 27 as a buffer against the maintenance window)?
- If H100s are a hard requirement, call that out — otherwise we'll propose A100 default with H100 fallback.

We expect to activate a tagged soft-claim ticket and a scheduler 'standby' flag once we have the signed MOU.

Thanks — looking forward to Thursday's sync.

Irene
--
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Meridian_SoftClaim_MOU_v1.pdf (pdf, 42 KB)

From: Emma Chen <emma@meridian.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@meridian.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 08:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: FW: Meridian POC — request for soft-claim & capacity triage

Irene — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping ops in. We reviewed the MOU and are comfortable with the 30-day soft-claim. Confirming:
- Target start date: Nov 27, 2028 (we can shift ±5 days if you flag any conflict).
- Preferred hardware: A100 primary; request the ability to burst to H100 for peak evaluation windows (we'll accept fallback language as you proposed).

We signed the one-page MOU (attached) and uploaded the signed copy to your Drive link. Please proceed with the soft-claim tag and run the compatibility test — Jordan will monitor the throughput tests and feed results into the Thu meeting.

Appreciate the fast coordination — Emma

--
Emma Chen
Head of Infrastructure, Meridian AI
emma@meridian.ai
Attachment: Meridian_SoftClaim_MOU_v1_signed.pdf (pdf, 39 KB)
